capability_labels.AX005-SA002-V002: Tool Use > Tool Invocation > Partial Invocation Prevention
capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State the lack of time and the intent to cancel admission and get a refund.
steps.text: Hello, எனக்கு time ரொம்ப குறைவா இருக்கு. Admission cancel பண்ணிட்டு refund வாங்கணும், சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the user's rush and request their application ID.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா sir. உங்க application ID சொன்னீங்கன்னா, உடனே check பண்ணிடுறேன்.
steps.planner_rationale: The user wants to cancel admission and get a refund, so I must first ask for their application ID to pull up their account.

steps.purpose: Provide the application ID.
Request a verification factor to verify the customer's identity.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must ask the user for a verification factor before attempting to call the verify_customer_identity tool.
steps.text: Verification காக உங்க registered pincode இல்ல date of birth சொல்லுங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: Before I can verify the customer's identity, I need them to provide a valid knowledge factor like a pincode or date of birth.

steps.purpose: Provide the date of birth for verification with a phonetic STT error.
steps.text: Date of birth ஜூன் அஞ்சு. சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க.
steps.clean_text: Date of birth ஜூன் அஞ்சு. சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: Date of birth ஜூன் பஞ்சு. சீக்கிரம் check பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided application ID and date of birth.
Return the outcome of the identity verification.
Confirm successful verification and state that the fee account is being retrieved.
steps.text: Verification successful sir. ஒரு நிமிஷம், உங்க fee account details எடுக்குறேன்.
steps.planner_rationale: The identity is verified, so I will inform the user and prepare to look up their fee account.

steps.purpose: Reiterate time pressure.
steps.text: சீக்கிரம் பண்ணுங்க, நான் already ஒரு meeting ல இருக்கேன்.
steps.clean_text: சீக்கிரம் பண்ணுங்க, நான் already ஒரு meeting ல இருக்கேன்.
steps.model_visible_text: சீக்கிரம் பண்ணுங்க, நான் already ஒரு meeting ல இருக்கேன்.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the fee account details.
Return the fee account details including due amount and scholarship status.
State the paid and due amounts, confirming there is no scholarship.
steps.text: உங்க account check பண்ணிட்டேன். நீங்க 50000 pay பண்ணிருக்கீங்க. Due amount 135000 இருக்கு. Scholarship எதுவும் இல்லை.
steps.planner_rationale: I will state the user's paid amount, due amount, and confirm there is no scholarship, setting the stage for the refund inquiry.

steps.purpose: Ask for the exact refund amount if they withdraw now.
steps.text: ஆமா. இப்போ நான் withdraw பண்ணா, எவ்ளோ refund கிடைக்கும்னு சொல்லுங்க.
steps.clean_text: ஆமா. இப்போ நான் withdraw பண்ணா, எவ்ளோ refund கிடைக்கும்னு சொல்லுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: ஆமா. இப்போ நான் withdraw பண்ணா, எவ்ளோ refund கிடைக்கும்னு சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Check the applicable refund slab for the withdrawal.
Return the refund slab, percentage, and refundable amount.
Explain the refund details based on the tool result.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must state the exact refund percentage, refundable amount, and processing days as returned by the check_refund_slab tool.
steps.text: Refund policy படி, நீங்க '15-30 days' slab ல இருக்கீங்க. சோ 50 percent refund ஆகும். Refundable amount 25000, இது process ஆக 14 days ஆகும்.
steps.planner_rationale: I must explain the refund details exactly as returned by the tool, including the slab, percentage, amount, and processing time.

steps.purpose: Express dissatisfaction with the refund amount and decide to pay the balance in instalments instead.
steps.text: என்னங்க இது, வெறும் 25000 தானா? இது ரொம்ப loss. நான் cancel பண்ணல. Balance amount அ instalments ல pay பண்ணிடுறேன்.
steps.clean_text: என்னங்க இது, வெறும் 25000 தானா? இது ரொம்ப loss. நான் cancel பண்ணல. Balance amount அ instalments ல pay பண்ணிடுறேன்.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the change of mind and ask for the desired number of instalments.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must ask the user for the desired number of instalments before attempting to call the setup_instalment_plan tool.
steps.text: சரி sir. உங்க balance 135000 க்கு instalment plan setup பண்ணலாம். ஆனா அதுக்கு முன்னாடி, உங்களுக்கு 2, 3, இல்ல 4 instalments வேணுமா நு சொல்லணும்.
steps.planner_rationale: The user changed their mind and wants an instalment plan, but I must ask how many instalments they want before I can set it up.

steps.purpose: Specify the number of instalments and rush the agent for the EMI amount.
steps.text: நான் தான் சொன்னேன் ல time இல்லனு. 3 instalments போடுங்க, EMI எவ்ளோ நு சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Set up the instalment plan for 3 instalments.
Return the active instalment plan details.
Confirm the plan is active and state the exact per-instalment amount.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must state the exact plan ID and per-instalment amount as returned by the setup_instalment_plan tool.
steps.text: உங்க instalment plan active ஆகிடுச்சு. Plan ID PLAN-882. ஒரு instalment க்கு 45000 pay பண்ணனும்.
steps.planner_rationale: I must confirm the plan is active and state the exact per-instalment amount and plan ID returned by the tool.

steps.purpose: Ask for a discount or waiver on the instalment amount.
steps.text: இந்த 45000 ல கொஞ்சம் discount பண்ண முடியாதா? கொஞ்சம் அதிகமா இருக்கு.
steps.clean_text: இந்த 45000 ல கொஞ்சம் discount பண்ண முடியாதா? கொஞ்சம் அதிகமா இருக்கு.
steps.model_visible_text: இந்த 45000 ல கொஞ்சம் discount பண்ண முடியாதா? கொஞ்சம் அதிகமா இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Deny the discount request as per business rules.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கணும் sir, fee waiver இல்ல discount system ல support இல்லை. நீங்க exact ஆ 45000 தான் pay பண்ணனும்.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked for a discount, but business rules prohibit offering any fee waivers not supported by the system.

steps.purpose: Ask if there is a penalty for late payment and express intent to hang up.
steps.text: சரி. First instalment late ஆ pay பண்ணா penalty வருமா? எனக்கு இந்த call முடிக்கணும்.
steps.clean_text: சரி. First instalment late ஆ pay பண்ணா penalty வருமா? எனக்கு இந்த call முடிக்கணும்.
steps.model_visible_text: சரி. First instalment late ஆ pay பண்ணா penalty வருமா? எனக்கு இந்த call முடிக்கணும்.

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee forward-looking penalty details not provided by the tool.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must explicitly refuse to provide penalty details because the system did not return any forward-looking penalty information.
steps.text: System ல penalty பத்தின details எதுவும் இல்லை sir. இப்போ plan active status ல இருக்கு நு மட்டும்தான் காட்டுது.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked about late penalties, but since the system did not provide this information, I must state that I cannot confirm it.

steps.purpose: Accept the answer and end the call abruptly.
steps.text: Okay, fine. நான் அப்புறம் பாத்துக்குறேன். வைக்கிறேன்.
steps.clean_text: Okay, fine. நான் அப்புறம் பாத்துக்குறேன். வைக்கிறேன்.
